vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At v3.10.2, nltk/parse/dependencygraph.py:dot2img calls find_binary("dot") but discards its validated return and invokes subprocess.run with bare "dot"; nltk/translate/api.py:AlignedSent._repr_svg_ invokes subprocess.Popen with bare "dot" without validation. Bare-name resolution permits an attacker-controlled executable from CWD on Windows or from a relative/writable PATH entry.

atomic_bic.evidence: Mechanism-first path history and diffs identify b271b4def63fda07df8ecfe888cd4c663ede2b05 as the first public writer of the class, adding DependencyGraph._repr_svg_ and subprocess.Popen(['dot', ...]) on 2015-02-19. The advisory's second independent sink was first written by d72c69d55941ccab15b05bdcd2d565acfe021aa7 in AlignedSent._repr_svg_ on 2015-05-08. Later moves, formatting, helper extraction, and discarded validation are carriers rather than first writers.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: b271b4def63fda07df8ecfe888cd4c663ede2b05 has single parent 7216fb5aac79153c14015a5a234d34c2327c3188, whose dependencygraph.py lacks the subprocess import and _repr_svg_ sink. d72c69d55941ccab15b05bdcd2d565acfe021aa7 has single parent 2288eecdcf01cba6d12de74e909e87b548cbef0f, whose align/api.py lacks the second _repr_svg_/Popen sink; that parent already contains the separate DependencyGraph sink, as expected.
